# OnePlusTwo

> OnePlusTwo is a UK company that provides cloud-based point of sale (EPOS) software and hardware, mainly for hospitality businesses (restaurants, cafes, takeaways, events and festivals, and food halls), and also for retailers and grocers. Based in Coventry, it serves businesses across the whole UK, with support 7 days a week.

All prices are in GBP and exclude VAT. Hardware is a one-off cost, separate from the monthly software plans.

## Software plans (per month + VAT)

- [Pricing](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/pricing): Starter £49 (order and table management, split payment and split bill, stock control, 7-day support). Essentials £79 (everything in Starter, plus a branded online ordering website, delivery app and other third-party integrations, VoIP integration, loyalty scheme, online table bookings). Premium £109 (everything in Essentials, plus mobile app integrations, multi-store capability and an assigned account manager).
- The ultimate bundle: £99 a month + VAT for the software licences of one POS and one self-service kiosk. Hardware is not included.
- Extra licences: £19 a month + VAT each for an additional till, kitchen display screen, collection display screen or menu screen. Self-service kiosks are £19 a month + VAT each from the second kiosk onwards.
- Delivery app integrations (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat) may carry an additional charge.

## Products

- [Point of sale](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/point-of-sale): cloud-based tills for hospitality and retail.
- [Self-service kiosks](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/self-service-kiosks): customers order and pay themselves. Kiosk packages from £799 + VAT.
- [Kitchen display screens](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/kitchen-display-screens): orders on screen in the kitchen. From £399 + VAT, plus £19 a month + VAT per screen.
- [Collection display screens](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/collection-display-screens): show customers when orders are ready. £19 a month + VAT per screen.
- [Online ordering website](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/online-ordering): branded ordering site for collection, delivery and QR code table ordering. Included in Essentials and Premium.
- [Table bookings](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/table-bookings): online reservations with table areas and live table status. Included in Essentials and Premium.
- [Menu screens and digital signage](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/digital-signage): £19 a month + VAT per screen.
- [Caller ID](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/caller-id): the caller's number appears on the till as the phone rings. Part of Essentials and Premium; needs the Artech VR1 USB caller ID box (£69 + VAT) and a VoIP phone line.
- [Integrated payments](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/integrated-payments): works with Dojo, Viva.com, DNA Payments and Paynt. Card processing rates vary by payment provider.
- [Integrations](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/integrations): Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat, Uber Direct, Otter and Xero.

## Hardware (one-off, + VAT)

- [Hardware](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/hardware): brands stocked are Sunmi, iMin, PAX and Zebra.
- [Shop](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/shop): complete till kits from £379 (Tablet POS £379, Sunmi D3 Mini £449, Sunmi D3 Pro £499, iMin Swan 2 Pro £499, Sunmi D3 80mm £749), each with a cash drawer and integrated card machine, plus an 80mm receipt printer (the Sunmi D3 80mm has its printer built in). Handheld POS: Sunmi P3 Mix £399, Sunmi V3 Mix £379. Self-service kiosk package: 22-inch £799, 27-inch £1,049. Artech VR1 caller ID box £69. Next day delivery by courier.

## Blog

- [How much does an EPOS system cost in the UK?](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/blog/epos-system-cost-uk): An EPOS system has two costs: a monthly software plan and one-off hardware. With OnePlusTwo, software starts at £49 a month + VAT and complete till kits start from £379 + VAT. Extra tills, kitchen screens and other add-ons are usually £19 a month + VAT each. Card processing fees are separate and vary by provider.
- [Running a food hall on one POS system: what to look for](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/blog/food-hall-pos-system): A food hall works best when the hall and every vendor run on one centralised POS system. Each vendor keeps its own menu, tills and kitchen screens, while the hall sees live sales across every vendor in one place. Self-service kiosks and collection screens help keep queues moving at busy times.
- [Online table bookings with live table status: how it works](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/blog/online-table-bookings-live-table-status): OnePlusTwo online table bookings let guests book a table on your website. They choose a date and time within your opening hours, pick a table area and select a free table, with table status shown live from your restaurant. Online reservations and table bookings are included in the Essentials and Premium plans.
- [How to choose a POS system for a takeaway](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/blog/choose-pos-system-takeaway): The best POS system for a takeaway brings every order into one place. Look for delivery app integrations (Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat), your own online ordering website, kitchen display screens, phone order support, clear reports across every channel and support 7 days a week, when you're actually open.
- [Are self-service kiosks worth it for a small restaurant or cafe?](https://www.oneplustwo.co.uk/blog/are-self-service-kiosks-worth-it): A self-service kiosk is usually worth it if you have counter service and queues at busy times. Kiosks shorten waits, suggest extras so orders are often bigger, and free your team to make and serve. With OnePlusTwo, kiosk hardware starts from £799 + VAT and the software from £59 a month + VAT.
